amendment_overrides: ARC→HS mainline independent of MMLU; R50 primary/REL10 secondary; HS selection allowed; 16 family cells +8 deployment cells; old CB insufficient-new-target branch does not stop mainline

literature.scope: reviewed9-paper representative family matrix, not all SOTA

historical_status: Followup protocol frozen after observing old HS results; not independent confirmatory evidence; does not adjust historical adaptive selection; old CV 97.5% intervals/SELECT_ONLY remain unchanged

cells.same_rows: same OOF models in all24 prediction columns; same percontext training/validation rows for every configuration

ridge.weights: v_m=1/(G*n_g) on current training rows; sum1
ridge.standardization: mu=sum v*X; sd=sqrt(sum v*(X-mu)^2); train-only; sd<=1e-12 => zero column in train and predict
ridge.fit: ybar=sum v*Y; beta=(Z^T diag(v) Z+lambda I)^-1 Z^T diag(v)(Y-ybar)

hgb.environment: isolated O2 environment; full dependency versions locked in A2; no install before V-P
hgb.weights: N_train/(G*n_g); sum N_train; no row-random validation
hgb.input: numeric float arrays, no extra standardization; all explicit+default get_params recorded under environment lock

selection.inner_loss: concatenate four heldout inner predictions; mean of per-org mean squared errors on pooled validation rows, not mean of four fold losses
selection.budget: each group/endpoint/outer same17 configurations ×4 inner fits; 9 ridge+8 HGB; retain best within each family and best across17
selection.ties: loss <= minimum+1e-12; prefer ridge; within ridge larger lambda; within HGB fewer leaves then larger L2 then lower learning_rate
selection.final_refit: Fit each family-selected configuration on all qualified outer-train rows. Select deployment among all17 using its own global minimum+1e-12 tie set. Reuse family final fit only if exact selected config ID matches; otherwise fit the globally selected existing configuration separately. No new search/configuration.

counts.deployment_extra_fit_condition: global-selected configuration ID differs from selected configuration of that family; count actual occurrences

selection.forbidden: no outer loss used for family/hyperparameter/feature/threshold selection

inference.unit: institution; each model equal within institution; institution equal
inference.primary: F_best versus C_best on HS Y_sel
inference.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); integers(0,G,size=(2000,G)); institution ID lexicographic order; repeated draws retained
inference.CI: numpy.quantile(...,[0.025,0.975],method=linear); percentile; pair same resampled institutions across all cells/contrasts
inference.conditioning: fixed OOF predictions, source/target items and labels; no refitting, no item bootstrap; CI not corrected for historical adaptive selection
inference.support: I>=0.05 AND lower95CI(delta)>0 AND >=4/5 outer-fold delta>0 => FOLLOWUP_PREDICTIVE_SUPPORT
inference.no_support: evaluable but failed any support condition => NO_PREDEFINED_PREDICTIVE_SUPPORT
inference.inconclusive: base loss<=1e-12, insufficient common sample, noncomputable CI => INCONCLUSIVE; report failure cause, never PASS unrun
inference.descriptive: Y_cal; F_best-L_best (joint s,sigma addition, no single-s attribution); within-family F-C and F-L; full24-cell MSE/CI matrix, not cherry-picked OR rule
inference.old_CV: do not subtract old/new cohort MSE or alter old interval levels

model_selection.case_unit: one outer-test org; only Q_H eligible candidate models
model_selection.candidates: A_m>=max withinorg Q_H A -0.02; at least3 candidates
model_selection.recommend: each group best predictor minimum predicted Y_sel; exact tie canonical model ID lexical; target column hellaswag required
model_selection.seal: candidates/recommendations/OOF/selection logs and hashes before target aggregate reveal
model_selection.U: mean case-org actual R50 of recommended model
model_selection.regret: mean case-org (recommended actual R50 minus minimum actual candidate R50); oracle used after seal only
model_selection.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_CASES; keep descriptive counts/results, never relax thresholds or target-spread filtering
model_selection.CI: 2000 paired case-org bootstrap, default_rng(20260914), separately sorted case-org ID indices;95% percentile [0.025,0.975]; all methods same draws
model_selection.decision_support: only primary FOLLOWUP_PREDICTIVE_SUPPORT AND D>=0.01 AND lower95CI(D)>0 => FOLLOWUP_DECISION_SUPPORT
model_selection.prediction_only: primary supported but selection not supported => PREDICTION_ONLY (preserve INSUFFICIENT_CASES substatus if applies)
model_selection.primary_not_supported: selection is DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY regardless of D; never replaces failed primary

cost.hardware: same recorded hardware, CPU single thread; OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR=1; no GPU/new LLM calls
cost.cold: first actual necessary O2 run, all exact-reference fits and auxiliary contexts measured; no free prior caches; count unique fits and contexts separately
cost.sharing: shared source I/O separately; B summaries prefix of C; C shared summaries; L/F shared ALS+projection physically once but charge standalone L and F required cost each; family/best tuning costs explicitly counted and not erased by reuse
cost.common_eligibility_audit: report F-based common-cohort screening cost separately from each deployable method prerequisites; standalone B/C do not require ALS, L/F do; do not obscure total benchmark audit cost
cost.warm: fixed first100 Q_H model IDs by SHA(seed|model_id) (all if<100); each model3 serial reps; all4 deployment groups for both endpoints on saved corresponding outer-trained reference/estimators; extraction from source raw ARC record, L/F projection, prediction included; target not read
cost.warm_order: for each repetition and model draw one permutation of B,C,L,F from single default_rng(seed) stream iterating rep then hash-ordered models; preserve measured order manifest
cost.warm_metrics: permethod permodel extract+project+predict wall/CPU; median and 25/75 percentiles; warm-cache timing labeled; shared I/O separately same allocation; amortization training population recorded
cost.low_cost_tradeoff: F_best vs C_best main HS I lower95CI > -0.01 AND preidentified cold or warm F/C cost ratio<=0.8; secondary only, not main win; all measured costs reported regardless of performance
cost.two_target_consistency: NOT_APPLICABLE mainline only; optional MMLU cohort may differ, never compute min(I_HS,I_M) or claim common-cohort stability

resources.pilot: A2 constructed response/labels only; maximum actual reference matrix dimensions with synthetic labels for HGB at full training rows/features and all8 configs; source-only reference pilot only after V-D before A3; original old2.2387s reference is planning evidence not new measurement
resources.estimate: all unique exact-reference fits +125 projection contexts+2720 supervised inner fits+80 family final fits+at most40 necessary deployment-only final fits+all data I/O+warm100x3x4; record measured extrapolation; >12h node => G-SCOPE before production
resources.environment_and_selftests: A2 only after V-P; no true target results during development; V-D before real source fit/target scoring

review.V_D: independent synthetic code/environment/design audit before real fitting/scoring
review.V_R: independent full result audit absolute numerical error<=1e-8
review.delivery: V-R then mainline manuscript; optional MMLU current status at cutoff; V-T then G-READ; no full R/new sensitivity/temperature/reverse task

protocol_correction: PROTOCOL_CORRECTION.md: non-transitive numerical tie sets; original17 configurations, loss thresholds, families, endpoints and plan hashes unchanged
